correction: The pages said any drop-in in /etc/systemd/coredump.conf.d/ with Storage=external keeps core files. systemd sorts /usr/lib and /etc drop-ins together by name and the last wins, so the file must sort after the image's 50-snosi.conf; ProcessSizeMax=1G also stops the stack trace for larger cores. Name the file (90-debug.conf) and the limit; check-site asserts both.
